document_kind: Coordinate contract; not a validation result

canonical_preparation.purpose: Legacy generator input and intermediate construction coordinates, not the physical handedness of the delivered Blender vehicle

blender_source.purpose: Final saved editable Blender world coordinates

unity_runtime.purpose: Existing CDLC runtime model coordinates; unchanged by the Blender source correction

legacy_input_fields.model-spec.json:doors[].centre_blender_y: canonical_preparation Y; X reflection leaves this component unchanged
legacy_input_fields.model-spec.json:door_leaves[].open_degre: Generator-local animation input; evaluate the final transformed hinge and inward opening in the saved source
legacy_input_fields.*_unity: unity_runtime unless a file explicitly states otherwise

historical_report_policy: Untagged *_blender positions and matrices from before the handedness correction may contain canonical_preparation coordinates. Preserve research history, but regenerate or explicitly tag current mirror, rig and placement metadata from the corrected source. A field name alone is not evidence of its coordinate space.
validation: Check the final saved source from front, both sides, open-door and actual driver-eye views. Do not dismiss a right-hand-drive source as a camera or viewer effect. verify_handedness.py writes the required hash-bound handedness-validation.json.
